##: Every push to main runs the release workflow, which rewrites `version`,
with jq — structure is edited by hand, digests are not. Zeroed hashes
are the bootstrap placeholders the first release after this file landed
`architecture.*.url` carries a CONCRETE version, derived by that job from
the matching `autoupdate` template. Scoop substitutes `$version` only
inside `autoupdate`, which is the block a bucket maintainer runs; an
install reads these urls verbatim, so a literal token here is a 404 for
these blocks against the release build matrix and fails on a `$version`
description: Local-first outliner with CRDT sync: TUI, CLI and MCP server (beta channel, rebuilt on every push to main)
notes: outl is on your PATH as `outl`. `outl --help` lists the commands; `outl init <dir>` scaffolds a workspace and `outl` with no arguments opens the TUI on today's journal.
This is the beta channel: it tracks every push to main. Pin a version with `scoop hold outl-beta` if you would rather upgrade on purpose.
